title: Co-Creative Learning via Metropolis-Hastings Interaction between Humans and AI
abstract: arXiv:2506.15468v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose co-creative learning as a novel paradigm where humans and AI, i.e., biological and artificial agents, mutually integrate their partial perceptual information and knowledge to construct shared external representations, a process we interpret as symbol emergence. Unlike traditional AI teaching based on unilateral knowledge transfer, this addresses the challenge of integrating information from inherently different modalities. We empirically test this framework using a human-AI interaction model based on the Metropolis-Hastings naming game (MHNG), a decentralized Bayesian inference mechanism. In an online experiment, 69 participants played a joint attention naming game (JA-NG) with one of three computer agent types (MH-based, always-accept, or always-reject) under partial observability. translated_title: 基于Metropolis-Hastings交互的人类与AI共创学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出“共创学习”作为一种新颖的范式，其中人类与AI（即生物智能体与人工智能体）相互整合各自的部分感知信息与知识，以构建共享的外部表征，我们将这一过程解释为符号涌现。与传统的基于单方面知识传递的AI教学不同，该范式应对了整合来自本质上不同模态的信息这一挑战。我们采用基于Metropolis-Hastings命名游戏（MHNG）的人类-AI交互模型——一种去中心化的贝叶斯推理机制——对该框架进行了实证检验。在一项在线实验中，69名参与者在部分可观测条件下，与三种计算机智能体类型之一（基于MH的、总是接受的、或总是拒绝的）进行联合注意命名游戏（JA-NG）。结果表明，与基于MH的智能体配对的人机组合通过交互显著提高了分类准确性，并实现了……
tldr: 该论文提出“共创学习”新范式，让人类与AI通过基于Metropolis-Hastings命名游戏的去中心化贝叶斯交互机制相互融合各自的部分感知信息以共同构建共享外部表征（符号涌现），实验证明这种双向共创机制相比单向知识传递显著提升了联合分类的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "co-creative learning," a novel paradigm in which humans and AI mutually integrate their partial perceptual information through a decentralized Bayesian interaction mechanism based on the Metropolis-Hastings naming game to construct shared external representations (symbol emergence), with experiments showing this bidirectional co-creative approach significantly improves joint categorization accuracy compared to unilateral knowledge transfer.
